recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. It is limited to active build inputs and resolves the remaining inconsistency without expanding into separate CareTeam membership-page or functional-list syntax policy work.
issue_request: FHIR-37846 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to replace the draft reference-search :in modifier with _in, retain _list rather than deprecating it, define List and Group membership rules, and have _in reference those rules.
initial_application: The original application removed reference :in/:not-in behavior, added Group and List membership prose, introduced _in examples, and added Resource-_in. A later resource-parameter rewrite changed Resource-_in to reference type and moved the documentation but left the SearchParameter without target codes and dropped the explicit _list retention/preference note.
additional_context: A FHIR-I Zulip implementation thread accepted CareTeam as an _in target, rejected Bundle, and left functional-list literals in _list as future work. FHIR-39342 later clarified the functional-list link for _list, so the reconciliation preserves _list-specific functional-list behavior while still documenting ordinary List membership through _in.
reconciliation: Added CareTeam, Group, and List targets to source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml for Resource-_in and added source/search.html prose explaining that ordinary List membership can use _in with a List target while _list remains for backward compatibility, systems not supporting broader _in membership, and functional-list literals.
source_changes: source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml: added CareTeam, Group, and List target codes to the Resource-_in SearchParameter.
source/search.html: added a _list note that directs ordinary List membership to _in when supported and preserves _list for compatibility and functional-list literals.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the functional-list link for _list and therefore constrains this reconciliation to preserve _list-specific functional-list behavior.
The originating large List/Group operations discussion raised membership-test concerns but is a broader operations issue not decided here.
